caption: The drawing depicts an ornamental metal architectural bracket with elaborate scrollwork and foliage motifs, rendered in shades of gray pencil on a beige background. The main structure consists of a vertical bar intersected by a horizontal bar at the top, forming an inverted T shape. Both bars are adorned with intertwined vine and leaf patterns, with grape clusters visible among the leaves. The scrollwork beneath the bars curves outward and downward, featuring symmetrical spirals and leaf shapes. To the left of the primary drawing, there is a smaller, simplified sketch of the same bracket, including dimensions marked as "10''" for the vertical width and "35''" for the horizontal length. The overall composition highlights the detailed, ornamental patterns, while leaving much of the background unmarked and plain.
title: Iron Porch Supports
